terra.problem: The lamp appears in verse 3, not the next verse after verse 1.
The text does not say Samuel was sure he recognized Eli's voice or that he had no way to guess who else was calling.
Samuel says Eli called him, but the text does not say Eli was the only possible caller he considered or give that as his reason.
The text does not say whether Samuel waited to hear the call a second time after lying down.
The text does not state that the word not yet being revealed to Samuel was why he went to Eli.
The explanation presents the unrevealed word as the reason Samuel ran to Eli, which the text does not state.
Calling Eli a priest draws on a fact outside this passage without a reference.
The passage does not mention a hallway.
The text does not say the earlier calls came from a distance.
Saying Eli is back in his room adds movement and a location at this point that the text does not specify.
Calling Eli a priest draws on a fact outside this passage without a reference.
The text does not report an order to keep quiet, but it does not establish that nobody gave Samuel one.
Samuel told Eli everything and hid nothing, but the text does not describe whether he softened any part of the message.
Calling Eli's reply calm assigns an unreported tone without marking it as Papa Dorin's impression.
